name: EC2 Docker

permissions:
  contents: write       # needed for creating approval issues
  issues: write         # needed for approval comments
  id-token: write       # only needed if using OIDC auth (safe to leave)

on:
  # workflow_dispatch:
  #     inputs:
  #         action:
  #             description: 'Action to perform'
  #             required: true
  #             default: 'apply'
  #             type: choice
  #             options:
  #                 - apply
  #                 - destroy
  # push:
  #   branches:
  #     - feat_tf_ci
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - feat_tf_ci
    paths:
      - 'infra/**'
      - 'backend/**'

env:
  AWS_REGION: us-east-1
  POSTGRES_USER: postgres
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
  POSTGRES_DB: testdb

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    name: Detect Code Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      infra_changed: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.infra }}
      app_changed: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.app }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            infra:
              - 'infra/**'
            app:
              - 'backend/**'

  infra-jobs:
    name: Deploy Infra
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: detect-changes
    if: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.infra_changed == 'true' }}
    outputs:
      infra_affects_app: ${{ steps.conditional.outputs.affects_app }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Configure AWS credentials via OIDC
      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::196031534418:role/GithubActions_youjay
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      # Setup Terraform
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3

      - name: Terraform Init
        run: terraform init -backend-config=backend.tfvars
        working-directory: infra/

      - name: Terraform Plan
        #if: ${{ github.event.inputs.action == 'apply' }}
        run: terraform plan -out=tfplan -var-file=dev.tfvars
        working-directory: infra/

      - name: Wait for manual approval
        #if: ${{ github.event.inputs.action == 'apply' }}
        uses: trstringer/manual-approval@v1
        timeout-minutes: 30             # Step will fail if no decision in 60 minutes
        with:
          secret: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          approvers: yoU-Jay  # comma-separated if multiple
          minimum-approvals: 1
          issue-title: "Approve Terraform apply?"
          issue-body: "Please approve or deny the Terraform plan apply."
          fail-on-denial: true

      - name: Terraform Apply
        #if: ${{ github.event.inputs.action == 'apply' }}
        run: terraform apply -auto-approve -var-file=dev.tfvars
        working-directory: infra/

      - name: Terraform Destroy
        if: ${{ github.event.inputs.action == 'destroy' }}
        run: terraform destroy -auto-approve -var-file=dev.tfvars
        working-directory: infra/

      # Capture Terraform outputs
      - name: Capture Infra Outputs
        id: tfoutputs
        run: |
          echo "ecr_repo=$(terraform output -raw ecr_repo)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "ec2_instance_id=$(terraform output -raw ec2_instance_id)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        working-directory: infra/

      # Update SSM parameters only if changed
      - name: Update Parameter Store
        id: conditional
        run: |
          CHANGED=false
          
          # --- ecr_repo ---
          NEW_VALUE="${{ steps.tfoutputs.outputs.ecr_repo }}"
          OLD_VALUE=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "/ci/ecr_repo" --query "Parameter.Value" --output text 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          if [ "$NEW_VALUE" != "$OLD_VALUE" ]; then
            echo "Updating /ci/ecr_repo → $NEW_VALUE"
            aws ssm put-parameter --name "/ci/ecr_repo" --value "$NEW_VALUE" --type String --overwrite
            CHANGED=true
          else
            echo "/ci/ecr_repo unchanged"
          fi
          
          # --- ec2_instance_id ---
          NEW_VALUE="${{ steps.tfoutputs.outputs.ec2_instance_id }}"
          OLD_VALUE=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "/ci/ec2_instance_id" --query "Parameter.Value" --output text 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          if [ "$NEW_VALUE" != "$OLD_VALUE" ]; then
            echo "Updating /ci/ec2_instance_id → $NEW_VALUE"
            aws ssm put-parameter --name "/ci/ec2_instance_id" --value "$NEW_VALUE" --type String --overwrite
            CHANGED=true
          else
            echo "/ci/ec2_instance_id unchanged"
          fi
          
          echo "affects_app=$CHANGED" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  app-jobs:
    name: Build or Use Existing Image & Deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - detect-changes
      #- infra-jobs
    if: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.app_changed == 'true' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::196031534418:role/GithubActions_youjay
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Fetch Infra Details
        run: |
          export ECR_REPO=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "/ci/ecr_repo" --query "Parameter.Value" --output text)
          export EC2_INSTANCE_ID=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "/ci/ec2_instance_id" --query "Parameter.Value" --output text)
          echo "ECR_REPO=$ECR_REPO" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "EC2_INSTANCE_ID=$EC2_INSTANCE_ID" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Login to Amazon ECR
        run: |
          aws ecr get-login-password --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} | \
          docker login --username AWS --password-stdin ${{ env.ECR_REPO }}

      # Case 1: App code changed → Build & Push new image
      - name: Build & Push New Image
        if: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.app_changed == 'true' }}
        run: |
          IMAGE_TAG=build-${{ github.sha }}
          docker build -t ${{ env.ECR_REPO }}:$IMAGE_TAG ./app
          docker push ${{ env.ECR_REPO }}:$IMAGE_TAG
          echo "IMAGE_TAG=$IMAGE_TAG" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      # Case 2: Only infra changed → Check if image exists in ECR
      - name: Check for Existing Image in ECR
        if: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.app_changed != 'true' }}
        run: |
          IMAGE_TAG=$(aws ecr list-images --repository-name $(echo $ECR_REPO | cut -d'/' -f2) \
            --query 'imageIds[0].imageTag' --output text)
          if [ "$IMAGE_TAG" == "None" ] || [ -z "$IMAGE_TAG" ]; then
            echo "❌ No existing image found in $ECR_REPO"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "✅ Found existing image: $IMAGE_TAG"
            echo "IMAGE_TAG=$IMAGE_TAG" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      # Common Deploy Step → EC2 via SSM
      - name: Deploy to EC2
        run: |
          aws ssm send-command \
            --targets "Key=instanceIds,Values=$EC2_INSTANCE_ID" \
            --document-name "AWS-RunShellScript" \
            --comment "Deploy app using docker-compose with ECR image" \
            --parameters 'commands=[
              "sudo yum update -y || sudo apt-get update -y",
              "if ! command -v docker &> /dev/null; then curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh; fi",
              "sudo systemctl enable docker",
              "sudo systemctl start docker",
              "if ! command -v docker-compose &> /dev/null; then curl -L \"https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/latest/download/docker-compose-$(uname -s)-$(uname -m)\" -o /usr/local/bin/docker-compose && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/docker-compose; fi",
              "aws ecr get-login-password --region $AWS_REGION | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin $(echo $ECR_REPO | cut -d'/' -f1)",
              "cd /home/ec2-user/app || mkdir -p /home/ec2-user/app && cd /home/ec2-user/app",
              "echo \"ECR_REPO=$ECR_REPO\" > .env.deploy",
              "echo \"IMAGE_TAG=$IMAGE_TAG\" >> .env.deploy",
              "echo \"POSTGRES_USER=$POSTGRES_USER\" >> .env.deploy",
              "echo \"POSTGRES_PASSWORD=$POSTGRES_PASSWORD\" >> .env.deploy",
              "echo \"POSTGRES_DB=$POSTGRES_DB\" >> .env.deploy",
              "docker-compose --env-file .env.deploy pull backend",
              "docker-compose --env-file .env.deploy up -d --force-recreate backend db"
            ]'
